prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one individual transparent RGBA 2D fighting-game character sprite for CQC Versus Legacy. Input image is the existing project reference for Null from Metal Gear Solid: Portable Ops. Preserve this exact incarnation and recognizable design: short tousled light blond hair, black high scarf/mask concealing nose and mouth, dark charcoal close-fitting tactical sleeveless/short sleeve suit, olive webbing harness and olive thigh pouch, red upper shoulder plate on his own right shoulder as in reference, long dark forearm gloves, dark segmented knee and shin armor, heavy black boots. Preserve his youthful slim athletic proportions; fully clothed. The reference is a small hand-painted game sprite: draw a higher-resolution clean hand-painted cel-shaded 2D sprite with crisp readable edges and restrained olive, charcoal and muted red palette, no photorealistic render. Body facing screen RIGHT in three-quarter side view. Full body including all hair, both hands and both boots must fit entirely inside canvas with a generous transparent margin. Exactly ONE person and ONE pose. Truly transparent alpha background, no floor, no shadow platform, no text, no panel, no sprite sheet, no duplicate, no weapon, no extra accessories. Keep anatomical side-specific gear in its correct position; do not mirror the reference. New pose: a low defensive guard. Null is in a deep stable crouch, pelvis lowered, both knees bent, front/right-facing foot planted forward and rear foot firmly back. Torso leans slightly toward the opponent on the right. Both gloved fists and forearms protect his masked face and upper chest, compact elbows tucked in. The pose should clearly read as blocking while crouched rather than attacking or crawling. Draw one still key pose, no motion blur or attack effects.
